text.p: American HealthChoice Inc said Friday it expected to report an after-tax loss of about $2.7 million for the fiscal year ended September 30.
The company said the losses were "substantially due to increased reserves for doubtful accounts, write down of good will, and other one-time write downs".
It said more than $1.8 million of the pre-tax loss was one-time write-offs, the majority good will.
The company said it also foresaw operating losses through at least the first two quarters of 1997.
"The company expects to return to a position of profitability as several of its new start-up clinics increase their reserve contribution and other operations are further streamlined," it said.
American HealthChoice Inc is a provider of healthcare services and operates primary care clinics located in Texas, Louisiana, and Georgia.
